Geofence zones

Define office or client zones — an engineer checked in outside all of these will be flagged as "outside zone" on the map and status list above.

Employee sequence

Every employee has one Sequence No., set on their own record, and it is the order they appear in everywhere — every report, sheet, export and email. Anyone without one is listed after everybody who has one, in name order. This gives the whole roster a clean 1, 2, 3 in the order they are listed in now, so there is somewhere to start from; after that, change an individual number on their record. It only ever writes the sequence — no salary, attendance, leave or past record is touched.

Document storage

New documents go straight to Google Drive, filed per employee, and the record keeps only the link. Records saved earlier still hold their images inside that employee's own record — which has a 50,000 character limit. Move them out here.

Every employee's record has that same 49 KB limit of its own — not only documents. If a save is refused with nothing left to move, this shows what is actually filling that employee's record.

Fields added to Employee Master over time — Workman Compensation, insurance, checklists and the rest — are stored on every employee even when left blank for them, and that unused space adds up across everyone on file. This removes only genuinely empty fields (blank text, empty lists) from every record. Nothing in use on any employee is touched, and no document, salary, PF, ESI, PT or leave figure changes.

A now-fixed bug could show the placeholder text "undefined" in a blank UAN, ESI number, PAN, Aadhaar, bank name, IFSC or account number box, and saving through the warning it then caused wrote that placeholder in as if it were a real value — which then falsely flagged as a duplicate against any other employee in the same state. Run this once to clear it off any record it reached.

If the same name turns up twice on the Salary Sheet or Attendance Sheet, this checks whether it is really two employee records rather than one — a shared name can be a genuine coincidence, so it only lists what it finds for you to check, it does not remove anything.

Always mark Present — bulk apply

For owners, family or anyone else who doesn't punch in day to day — this is the same "Always mark Present from" field as on each employee's own Employee Master record, just set on several at once instead of opening each one's Edit form individually. Tick everyone this should apply to, pick the date it starts from, and Apply.

Attendance Sheet

Auto-marks Present when an engineer checks in with their selfie. Everything else — leave, holidays, half-days — is entered or corrected by HR. Resident Engineers are excluded from the leave/late-coming rules; their days just track Present/Absent/Holiday.

Salary Sheet

Grouped by heading — set once per employee in Employee Master, and the Basic/HRA/LTA formula for that heading applies automatically every month. Leave days are pulled from the Attendance Sheet (Absent + LP days) for the month selected.

One month before an employee's increment date, they'll show up here so HR can send a reminder — review and send it yourself by email or WhatsApp.

Bond end dates coming up in the next 30 days, from Employee Master.

Employee Loan & EMI

A shortcut for the Loan & EMI section already on the employee's own record — this saves straight to it, so the Salary Sheet, PF, ESI and every report pick it up exactly as if it had been entered in Employee Master. Nothing else on the record is touched.

Salary Advance Payment

A shortcut for the Salary Advance Payment section already on the employee's own record — this saves straight to it. Add one entry per month; each month's Salary Sheet only ever recovers what is entered here for that exact month.

Reports

View attendance, leave, payroll and employee reports — tap a section to open it.

Attendance

The same attendance the Attendance Sheet records for this employee — Present, Absent, EL/SL/LP and half-days — one employee's calendar at a time. Sundays and declared holidays are excluded from the Absent count automatically.

Holidays

Yearly Total Leave Report

Every employee's leave days (EL + SL + LP, half-days counted as 0.5) broken down month by month across the financial year — April through March — so you can see each person's full-year leave pattern at a glance.

Monthly Leave Detail Report

Late coming, EL/PL, SL, full day leave, half days and short leaves for one month, side by side. Only employees who actually took something are listed — anyone with a clean month is left out. Whoever has the highest count in a column is shown in red, so it's easy to see at a glance who to have a word with. Opens on last month, the month the automatic email on the 1st reports.

EL SL Current Status

Every employee's Earned Leave and Sick Leave balance, month by month across the financial year — opening, used and closing for each. Each month's closing carries into the next as its opening, and March's closing is the balance left at year end.

Yearly Leave Detail Report

The same breakdown — late coming, EL/PL, SL, half days, short leaves — one table per category, month by month across the financial year with a Total column. The highest count in each column is shown in red.

PF Report

PF deducted per employee for the month, pulled from the Salary Sheet. Apprentices, R.S.IT Solution and Contractors don't have PF, so they're excluded here.

ESI Report

ESI deducted per employee for the month, pulled from the Salary Sheet. Apprentices, R.S.IT Solution and Contractors don't have ESI, so they're excluded here.

PT Report

Professional Tax deducted per employee for the month, pulled from the Salary Sheet. Apprentices and Contractors don't have PT — Managerial, Seniors, Junior Staff, and R.S.IT Solution do, when Gross exceeds ₹12,000.

Apprentice Salary Report

Full salary breakdown for employees under the Apprentices heading only, for the month you pick — pulled from the Salary Sheet.

Final Salary Sheet for Accountant

The payment list: every employee grouped by salary heading, sorted by bank within each heading, with account number and the final amount payable after all deductions. Built for handing to the bank — one block per heading, subtotalled, with a grand total at the end.

Diwali Bonus Payment Sheet

The payment list for the bonus, in the same shape as the Final Salary Sheet — grouped by salary heading, sorted by bank, with account number and the amount payable. An employee appears once they are marked eligible and have a Diwali bonus amount set on their record; anyone eligible without one is named above the table rather than left off quietly. No PF, ESI, Professional Tax, advance, loan or retention is deducted, and leave taken during the year does not reduce it.

Consultant Report

The monthly attendance sheet in the exact column format the consultant asks for — one row per employee, built automatically from Employee Master and the month's attendance. Pick any month; export the CSV and send it on.

Consultant Final Summary Report

PF Account No 1/2/10/21/22 and the ESI summary, totalled for the month across R.S. Infotech's own payroll headings — the same figures the consultant's filing sheet totals, pulled from Employee Master and this month's attendance.

Month-wise Salary Comparison

Last month's total salary against the month you pick, and exactly what explains the gap — each new joiner that added to it, each leaver that took away from it, and anyone whose own salary moved. The reasons add up to the difference.

Overtime Report

Applies to Field Engineers per the overtime policy. Log hours HR has been informed of (by the following day, per policy) — this is manual since overtime is reported over WhatsApp, not through this app.

Employee Wise Detail Report

One consolidated profile for a single employee — pick anyone, including those who have left.

Leave Balance Next Year Report

SL and EL together, for the financial year you pick — SL resets to the yearly allowance for each employee's type; EL is earned at 1 day per 25 days present (from the Attendance Sheet), unchanged from how the EL Calculation Sheet always worked. Resident Engineers are excluded from both; Work From Home and non-R.S. Infotech headings are excluded from SL only, shown as "—" in the SL columns. Run once, in April.

Generator

Generate HR reports, letters and calculation sheets — tap a section to open it.

Office Old Documents

Upload, search, view and manage the company's old-document archive from here. Files are stored on Google Drive under HR Management > Office Old Documents > folder > year, and the folder is created the first time you file something into it — you never need to open Drive to upload or find a document.

Employee Role Reports

A branded A4 report built from one employee's job profile, responsibilities, designation and department — the measures, risks and recommendations change with the role. Fill in Job profile and Key responsibilities in Employee Master first; without them the report falls back to designation and department and says so.

Company letterhead

Printed in the header and footer of every generated report. Anything left blank is left off the report rather than filled with a placeholder.

Used on the Consultant Final Summary Report.

Whoever is picked here signs every generated letter and the "Approved by (HR)" line on Role Reports — their name, specimen signature and mobile number come straight from their own Employee Master record, so update it there, not here.

Holiday List (to share with engineers)

A printable holiday list with the company logo, for a chosen financial year (April–March) — built from the Holidays list above.

Leave Encashment Report

What is owed for unused privilege leave at the year end, as at 31 March. Grouped by salary heading and sorted by bank with account numbers, so it can be paid the same way as the salary and the bonus. Resident Engineers are outside the EL scheme and do not appear.

Checklists

Joining checklist, items issued at joining, and the exit checklist — same lists that were under "Choose a letter" before, kept together here since they're not letters.

CTC Calculator for Employer

Check the exact CTC or take-home salary before appointing anyone — enter either one and the other is worked out from it, using the same Salary Heading split and PF/ESI/PT rules the Salary Sheet uses. Not tied to any employee record; nothing here is saved.

Rate of Pay Calculator

For a new employee — enter a Rate of Pay and see the exact Take Home Salary it produces, using the same Salary Heading split and PF/ESI/PT rules the Salary Sheet uses. Not tied to any employee record; nothing here is saved.

Take Home Salary Calculator

For a new employee — enter an agreed Take Home Salary and see the Rate of Pay it needs, using the same Salary Heading split and PF/ESI/PT rules the Salary Sheet uses. Not tied to any employee record; nothing here is saved.

Monthly CTC Calculator

For a new employee — enter a monthly CTC and see the Rate of Pay and Take Home Salary it works out to, using the same Salary Heading split and PF/ESI/PT rules as the other two calculators. Not tied to any employee record; nothing here is saved.
